comments.author: @debracook8859
comments.text: I had the privilege of spending five very bizarre days on the island of Saint Pierre about 10 years ago. You mentioned that most people living on the island have never been to continental France, which is not quite true. The French government offers grants for territorial students living on the island who want to study in France. It was my understanding then that most students do spend a few years in France studying. This keeps the culture pure. In this way, every new generation has the opportunity to experience European French life.

replies.author: @kerouan159
replies.text: The local government, and not the French one, offers a monthly grant for local students when they go study abroad, regardless of which country they go to. Now it's 60% France, 40% mostly Canada and others.

replies.author: @themaps26
replies.text: That sounds like such a fascinating experience! Saint Pierre definitely has that unique, surreal atmosphere where France meets North America. Would love to hear what stood out to you most during your visit
